materials_exhausted.note: Local material was sufficient to repair Table 1 EC50 rows and qualitative toxicity/mechanism claims. Exact peptide sequence strings/DBAASP sequence-position identity were not present locally and are preserved as nonblocking database cautions.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP literature links are source-verified to article metadata. Assay rows are matched to XML Table 1 EC50 values or source-supported qualitative toxicity at 1 mg/mL, but exact peptide sequence/position identity is not in local primary material, so assay rows remain source_conflict cautions rather than fully source_verified identity records.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Worker-2 repaired the unsupported Table 1 shape into four EC50 rows with raw mg/mL values, ug/mL normalized comparisons, Vero E6/SARS-CoV-2 target context, CIs, assay conditions, and source locators. Qualitative toxicity evidence was captured without fabricating figure-only numeric rows.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism record separates phenotypic antiviral activity from computational docking; no direct experimental mechanism is claimed.

caution_findings.evidence_context: No local sequence rows or primary-text peptide sequences were found; database assay rows preserve source_conflict status for sequence identity while source-supported assay values are recorded.
Figures provide additional toxicity/plaque/viability outcomes, but only Table 1 provides row-level EC50 values. Qualitative and prose percentages were recorded only where local text supports them.

adjudication_summary: Source re-review repaired the prior Table 1 activity blocker, cross-matched DBAASP assay values against local primary XML/prose/SI material, and closed rwk-complete-test-0001. The paper is publication-grade with cautions: exact peptide sequence identity is not recoverable from local primary materials, and figure-only numeric values were not invented.
